about: Picture brief for La Gran Fuga de Dubái (gameType 'escape', docs/specs/gran-fuga-de-dubai.md). Version 1 shipped with canvas drawings (public/js/escape-render.js: Robotín, the zona segura rooms and props, the zap; public/js/host-escape.js: the run scene's control tower, gate, fountain) + the art that already exists (Dubai skyline, landmark pieces, saga avatars, cast stickers, Dralingo in his platform look, the saga plane as Hamdan's jet). Made 2026-10-13 without any image generator (the GPU was busy). Make these with the higgsfield-art skill in his Chrome (Nano Banana Pro, Unlimited ON) or the local AI studio when the GPU is free. Originals -> assets-library/higgsfield/<date>/escape/<world>/<slug>.png; stickers on GREEN are keyed to transparent WebP (video_tools keying, like the cast stickers); web copies -> public/assets/escape/<world>/<slug>.webp (Pillow thumbnail 512 for stickers, 1600 wide for backdrops, WebP q82, each under 300 KB). Then swap the matching canvas drawing (the 'replaces' field) for a drawImage of the picture. Robotín must stay goofy and friendly, never scary: round, pastel, googly screen eyes, a broom, blush; his zap is blue tickle-lightning that makes kids giggle and dizzy, never hurts.
style: Premium glossy 3D animated movie style, cute toy-like characters and objects, rounded shapes, soft pastel colors, Dubai golden-hour light (peach, pink and lilac sky), soft studio lighting. <SUBJECT> Centered, the whole subject visible with a little margin. <BG> background. Kid friendly. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no signs with writing, no brand names, no airline markings.
robotin: Robotín, the goofy guard robot of the Museo del Futuro: a round egg-shaped robot, glossy white-silver body, a pastel orange guard belt with a round gold badge (no letters), a dark teal screen face with two big googly white eyes and a wobbly cyan smile, pink blush on the cheeks, a short antenna with a little red bulb, small tank-tread wheels, one little arm waving and the other holding a wooden broom with yellow bristles. Friendly, clumsy, funny, never scary. Pose: <POSE> Alone, no other characters.
dralingo: Same character as the first reference image: Dralingo, the cute glossy 3D cartoon blue baby dragon with big turquoise eyes, white belly, turquoise head spikes and blue wings with white membranes, dressed like the second reference image: a real Emirati white kandura, a white ghutra headscarf with a black agal, and a neat black curled mustache with a short trimmed black beard. Plain wings with no letters or symbols. Pose: <POSE> Alone, no other characters.
cast: Same character as the reference image: <WHO>. Glossy 3D cartoon render like a premium animated movie. <SCENE> Alone (the only person in the picture).

music.note: Chase pass 2026-10-19: ONE chase track for the whole episode on the projector (phones play no music), its mood set live by Web Audio (calm / chase / danger / zone / final: a filter and its speed, host-escape.js MOODS). His pick 2026-10-19: a 70.2 s loop of 'Desert Storm' (drum & bass) by lemonmusicstudio, Pixabay Content License, https://pixabay.com/music/drum-n-bass-desert-storm-109271/ (the full track stays in assets-library/pixabay/2026-10-19-escape-music/). Swap: node scripts/escape-sounds.js --music <file> and paste the printed line into host-escape.js MUSIC. Replaces Kenney 'Mission Plausible' (music-run) and 'Wacky Waiting' (music-zone).
